planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool and assigning each a unique, high-cognitive-load assessment facet. To ensure non-redundancy and high difficulty, I avoided simple recall (REMEMBER) and focused on ANALYZE and EVALUATE levels. The facets chosen (ERROR_DIAGNOSIS, BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE, THEORETICAL_RATIONALE, OFF_BY_ONE_ANALYSIS, and ARCHITECTURAL_COMPARISON) target common pitfalls in binary search and partitioning logic, such as infinite loops, index out-of-bounds errors, and subtle off-by-one mistakes in median calculation.
